# Welcoming Everett Hu to Infinite


We are excited to announce that Everett Hu has joined Infinite as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, helping to shape and lead our product engineering efforts.


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


March 16, 2026


·


1 min read


Team


We’re thrilled to welcome Everett Hu as as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, helping to shape and lead our product engineering efforts.


Everett is an industry leader at the intersection of traditional and blockchain financial services and product engineering, and brings a rare blend of practitioner depth and product leadership.


He’s built products ground up at high-growth fintechs like NerdWallet, then led product engineering and product strategy at companies like dYdX. That combination of frontline financial services experience and product thinking aligns perfectly with what we are building here at Infinite.


At Infinite, our platform is an embedded layer across our customers' products. Everett’s expertise reinforces that layer and accelerates our mission to build the best stablecoin experience for global commerce.


Excited to have you on board, Everett!
